title: There is no way to find an item by its title
description:
tinytodo/store.py defines `Store` with `add`, `complete` and `all`. `all()` is at line 26 and returns every item; with a few hundred items that is useless for finding one. Add a `search(self, term)` method to `Store` in tinytodo/store.py, directly after `all()`.

It returns a list of the item dicts (the same `{"id", "title", "done"}` dicts `all()` returns) whose `title` contains `term` as a substring, compared CASE-INSENSITIVELY, in insertion order. An empty `term` matches every item. A term that matches nothing returns an empty list. `search` must not modify the store. Do not change `add`, `complete` or `all`, and every test already in tests/test_store.py must still pass unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: it matches term as a case-insensitive substring of title
it returns whole item dicts in insertion order
an empty term matches everything and an unmatched term returns []
it does not modify the store
every test in tests/test_store.py still passes, unchanged
